text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah... you don't think the claw in this 
machine is weak, do ya?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So it's not like yer skills were lackin' 
or anythin', the difficulty was just 
cranked to MAX from the get-go. So, ya 
know...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Put that wallet away, please...! Any more 
than this and we're in way too deep...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Uggh, no more...! I can't stand watchin' 
money vanish right before my eyes 
anymore...!!
It ended in a disappointing result...
